adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the blacklist is normalized to lowercase (`BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(...).map(email => email.toLowerCase())`), but the filter compares with the raw `guest` string (`!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`), which is case-sensitive. Since `guests` come from input and are not lowercased, a mixed-case email (e.g., `Blocked@Example.com`) can bypass the blacklist. Also, when all inputs are filtered out (duplicates or blacklisted), it throws `BAD_REQUEST` with message `emails_must_be_unique_valid`, which is misleading for the blacklisted case.
